data.narrative:
Ultima Genomics is a Series C–stage biotech company that has raised $700M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 3 public-market peers in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and New Limit.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x multiplier to the $700M total raised proxy, yielding $1.2B. Peer-median analysis anchors to the median valuation of 3 same-sector, same-stage comparables: $3.8B (range $3.1B–$10.3B). Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied because the target's revenue is not disclosed. These two methods produce a triangulated range of $1.0B (low) to $4.4B (high), with a median of $2.5B.

The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around stage-appropriate valuation step-up rates and peer heterogeneity—notably, Colossal Biosciences trades at $10.3B within the peer set while others cluster near $3.1B–$3.8B. Stage-progression suggests a more conservative baseline, while peer-median implies material post-Series-C premium. Revenue disclosure or a tighter peer match would narrow this band. Key unknowns include capital efficiency, clinical-stage progress, and IP defensibility relative to the peer cohort.
